entities.summary: Samuel Joseph Aquila is an American Catholic prelate served as metropolitan archbishop of Denver in Colorado from 2012 to 2026. He was bishop of Fargo from 2002 to 2012. He is on the board of directors for the Fellowship of Catholic University Students.
